title: docs(changeset): five pending notes state what the next 18.0.0 prerelease ships, amended in place (Hono currentRecord; organization_id drop gate)
body:
Fixes #23703
Clause-②: no

Release text only. This PR amends eight pending changesets in place, so each says what the next `18.0.0` prerelease actually ships. Later PRs in the same release made some of their sentences false:
- **Rows 1 and 2.** Two notes said a Hono door's `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` holds `currentRecord` back. Since PR #23667 (`5bb9a83bd0`), both Hono doors forward it: the caller's own read of the row.
- **Row 3.** The v18 boot-refusal note said `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` refuses the `organization_id` drop only on the ceremony's inventory tables. Since PR #23699 (`6074eafb63`, `merged: true`), it holds back every such drop.
- **Patch round 1, same family.** The seat's review folded two more notes into this PR:
  - `@objectstack/hono`'s "Known gap" paragraph. PR #23582 and PR #23667 close that gap.
  - The `sys_metadata` family note's trail-door admission. PR #23674 narrows it.
- **Patch round 2.** `23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md`, already amended here (row 4), is now left fully true.
  - Its DELETE_RESTRICTED FROM and its "unchanged" sentence get the per-door treatment of rows 13-15.
  - Its duplicate-insert example now states what PR #23682 ships (rows 19-21).
- The later notes that pointed at these are amended only where the amendment makes them false.

No new changeset, no erratum sentence, and no code, test, docs page or `CHANGELOG.md`.

**A correction to round 1, made in this round.** Round 1 said the later `#23531` note's new FROM was "the body `18.0.0-next.1` answered: `code` and `message` only". That holds for a route mounted on `HonoHttpServer` only. In `18.0.0-next.1`, `createHonoApp` answered a stale `If-Match` with `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`. The evidence:
- At `0c52e43075`, `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts:793-794` answers a throw with `errorJson(c, err.message …, err.statusCode || 500)`.
- `ConcurrentUpdateError` declares `status = 409` and no `statusCode` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` at `0c52e43075`, the class at `:2867-2869`).
- `@objectstack/hono`'s own entry for #23365 states it in its FROM (`23365-hono-declared-envelope.md:14-17`).

Both `#23531` notes now name each door's last-published answer (rows 3, 5-7 and 13-15 below).

Readings:
- `.changeset/pre.json` is `{"mode":"pre","tag":"next"}` and has no `changesets` key, so it records no consumed changeset.
- The newest version cut is `0c52e43075` (`chore: version packages (next)`, 2026-10-14 10:19Z, `18.0.0-next.1`).
  - `git merge-base --is-ancestor 0c52e43075 ADDED_AT` exits 0 for every row above.
- None of the eight files is in `.changeset/pre/`, the archive of the 582 notes earlier cuts consumed.
  - The control `git merge-base --is-ancestor a87d8be299 0c52e43075` also exits 0.
- npm `dist-tags.next` is `18.0.0-next.1`.
- The published `18.0.0-next.1` tarballs were checked against `origin/main`. For `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/runtime`, the tarball's `CHANGELOG.md` is byte-identical (`cmp`) to the one on `origin/main`.
  - Hono: `currentRecord` counts 0, `currentVersion` 0 and `Known gap` 0.
  - CLI: the drop-gate refusal terms count 0.
  - REST and runtime: the trail-door terms count 0.
  - Positive control: `## 18.0.0-next.1` counts 1 in each.
- At `0c52e43075`, `apply.ts` has 0 `organization` references, and the drop-gate file is absent.
- The trail doors at `0c52e43075`:
  - history, audit and diff admitted `studio.access`, `setup.access` or `manage_metadata` (`rest-server.ts:1824-1829`, through `mayReadPendingDrafts`);
  - commits admitted `studio.access` or `setup.access` (`packages.ts:1887`, `requireReadCapability`);
  - `sys-metadata-audit.object.ts` carried no `requiredPermissions`.

So every pair compiles into **one** release. Following the ruling, each pair now tells one story: the earlier note states the final behaviour, and no FROM / TO describes a state that no release shipped.

## How each pair was made one story

**The two `#23531` notes.**
- **The earlier note (`23531-hono-conflict-body.md`) states the final body.**
  - Its TO carries `currentRecord` beside `currentVersion`, and `:15` states what `currentRecord` is.
  - Its FROM (`:8`, `:10`) and its "unchanged" sentence (`:13`) name each door's `18.0.0-next.1` answer: a `HonoHttpServer` route answered `409` with `code` and `message`, and `createHonoApp` answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
  - Its `:17` no longer points at the `#23365` "Known gap", which is gone.
- **The later note (`23531-hono-conflict-current-record.md`)** carries the same per-door FROM and the same TO.
  - Its "This supersedes the earlier note …" sentence is deleted.
- **`23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md`** (patch round 2).
  - `:14` loses its hold-back sentence.
  - `:7` and `:9` name each door's `18.0.0-next.1` answer to `DELETE_RESTRICTED`: a `HonoHttpServer` route answered `409` with `code` and `message`, and `createHonoApp` answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
  - `:12`'s "unchanged" clause is per door.
  - `:12`'s duplicate-insert example now says these doors answer the engine's `DUPLICATE_RECORD` as `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, so the classification agrees and its fields ride `details`. That matches `23587-hono-unique-violation.md` (`:5`, `:14`), which is not edited.

**`@objectstack/hono`'s `#23365` note (`23365-hono-declared-envelope.md:51-56`).** The "Known gap" paragraph is replaced by what ships: the `409` carries `currentVersion` and `currentRecord` in `error.details`. Its FROM (`:14-17`, `500` on `createHonoApp`) was already the `18.0.0-next.1` behaviour and is unchanged.

**The `organization_id` drop-gate pair.**
- `23429-v18-boot-refusal.md` says any table (`:20`, `:27`).
- `23684-drop-gate-host-tables.md`'s FROM names the `18.0.0-next.1` behaviour (no drop held back), and its TO loses "As before,".
- Kept as true: its title ("… not only the platform inventory's"), "with the existing refusal" (the refusal the boot-refusal note introduces in this same release), and its measurement sentence.

**The trail-door pair.**
- `23429-sys-metadata-family-organization-column-retired.md:49` states the merged admission:
  - history, audit and diff admit `studio.access` or `manage_metadata`;
  - commits admits `studio.access` alone;
  - `setup.access` alone is refused at all four.
- Its "only `manage_metadata`" clause now covers the history and audit rows, not the commit rows.
- `23546-trail-doors-setup-access.md`'s FROM / TO bullets (`:18-23`) are the `18.0.0-next.1` → final pair as written: "was 200" for a `setup.access` caller is what `0c52e43075` answered.
- Its `:14` said the data door "already refused them". The data door's `requiredPermissions` gate ships in this same release (`dd29bbe60d`), so `:14` now says it "refuses them".

## Before / after: every amended sentence

Before is the text on `origin/main`; after is the text at this head. Code was read on `origin/main` `6074eafb63`, except **[H]** and **[I]**, which were read at `0c52e43075` (`18.0.0-next.1`):
- **[A]** `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts:367`: `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` merges `declaredArmContext(...)` into `details`.
- **[B]** `adapter.ts:462-475`: every arm key but `error` and `code` is forwarded; nothing is held back by name.
- **[C]** `types/src/data-error-classification.ts:1046-1053`: the `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` arm carries `currentVersion` and `currentRecord`.
- **[D]** `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:15027-15031`: a version mismatch re-reads the row with `readAsCaller`, and throws `ConcurrentUpdateError` with `currentRecord: visible`.
- **[E]** `adapters/hono/src/index.ts:554`: `createHonoApp` renders through `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`.
- **[F]** `cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-drop-gate.ts:47-55`: every intended `drop_column organization_id`, no table filter.
- **[G]** `cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts:494-523`: the refusal, before `flushSchemaDdl` (`:558`).
- **[H]** At `0c52e43075`:
  - `apply.ts` has no `organization` reference, and there is no drop-gate file;
  - `adapters/hono/src/index.ts:793-794` answers `err.statusCode || 500`;
  - `ConcurrentUpdateError` declares `status` only;
  - `spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts:192` maps `500` to `INTERNAL_ERROR`;
  - the direct-mount route's `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` (`plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts:284`) had no arm context.
- **[I]** The trail doors at `0c52e43075`, as listed in the readings above.
- **[J]** `rest/src/rest-server.ts:1868`: `AUTHORING_TRAIL_READ_CAPABILITIES = ['studio.access', 'manage_metadata']`.
  - `:1886-1892`: `mayReadAuthoringTrail` admits `isSystem` or one of those.
  - It is asked by `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (`:1920-1921`) at history `:7629`, audit `:7766` and diff `:8239`.
- **[K]** `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:381-395`: `requireCommitTrailReadCapability` admits `isSystem` or `studio.access` only. It is asked at `GET /packages/:id/commits` (`:1972`).
- **[L]** `metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit.object.ts:238`: `requiredPermissions: ['studio.access']`, added by `dd29bbe60d`.
- **[M]** The `DELETE_RESTRICTED` producer:
  - at `0c52e43075`, `objectql/src/engine.ts:18664-18666` sets `code`, `status = 409` and `httpStatus = 409`. The file has no `statusCode` at all, so next.1 `createHonoApp` ([H], `index.ts:793-794`) answered `500`;
  - `spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts:97` registers `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, so the next.1 direct-mount `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` (`adapter.ts:284`) answered `409`;
  - on this base the same lines are `engine.ts:18728-18730`.
- **[N]** `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts:362`: `const code = isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope(thrown) ? 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION' : resolved.code;`, decided before the arm is asked.
  - The docblock `:289-308` ("One wire spelling") explains the ordering.
  - The arm must then agree on status and code (`:466-468`), which it does for `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`.

## The bounded sweep (the seat's four behaviours, every pending `.changeset/*.md`)

The sweep covered 113 pending files: the 111 top-level `.md` under `.changeset/` on this branch (excluding `README.md`; the consumed archive `.changeset/pre/` is not pending), plus 2 more on `main`. pre.json lists none of them.
- 105 were added after `0c52e43075`.
- The 2 on `main`, `23630-promote-doors-d99.md` and `23686-dispatcher-unique-violation.md`, landed after this branch's base and were read from `origin/main` `395ca21cc7`. `23630` hits `?package=` at `:19` and `:22`; both describe the server's publish door in its own note and are true. `23686` hits nothing.
- 6 were added on 2026-10-14 before the cut and were never consumed (`23268-external-sharing-model-retired`, `23268-skills-lint-rules-row`, `23357-page-component-view-data-api-refused`, `23387-two-master-names-release`, `23397-ceremony-builtin-positions`, `23399-ceremony-not-declared-column-drop`). They were grepped too and hit nothing.

**`currentRecord` / `currentVersion`.**
- Amended: rows 1-3, 5-8 and 13-16.
- Judged still true:
  - `23531-hono-conflict-body.md:6` and `23531-hono-conflict-current-record.md:6` (the titles), and both notes' `:11` (TO).
  - `23406-sealed-first-draft-remedy.md:15` and `23577-sealed-write-one-sentence.md:21`: the `/meta` conflict and spec schemas, not a Hono door.
  - `23586-occ-conflict-caller-visibility.md:9`, `:13`, `:14`: the protocol. Its `:16` says the Hono hosts get the narrowed answer, which they do ([B] [D]).
- `23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md:12`: its `currentVersion` clauses are true ([B] [C]). Its other two clauses were amended in patch round 2 (row 21).

**`setup.access` at the trail doors.**
- Amended: rows 17 and 18.
- Judged still true: `23546-trail-doors-setup-access.md:6`, `:18-22` (each "was 200" matches [I]; "now 403" matches [J] [K]), `:27-29` (who is still admitted: [J] [K]), `:33` (draft switches), `:34` (package reads, `requireReadCapability`) and `:37`. Its `:10` is the ADR-0087 disposition marker and is unchanged.

**"inventory" at the drop gate.**
- Amended: rows 9-12.
- Judged still true:
  - `23684-drop-gate-host-tables.md:5` (title), `:9` (disposition: "a table outside the platform inventory is refused", which is still a subset of every table) and `:17` ("read without a copy of its inventory").
  - `15211-cli-apply-reviewed-plan.md:16`: the ceremony plan's inventory digest, not the drop gate.

**`publishItem` / `?package=`.** No amendment.
- `23658-client-publish-package.md` is PR #23680's own note.
- No other note says the client cannot name a package on a publish.
- `23495-draft-doors-one-address.md:19`, `:27`, `:28`, `:33`, `:35` prescribe `?package=`, which the client now sends.
- `23183`, `23214`, `23291`, `23350`, `23415`, `23416`, `23473` and `23501` use `?package=` on reads, saves, deletes, uninstall and `/automation`, none of which the publish change touches.

## Check Changeset

This diff edits existing changesets and adds none, so `Check Changeset` reads it as the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class (`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`, route 0 of `pr-automation.yml`). It is red by design, and I made no attempt to turn it green. No `skip-changeset` label, under ruling D on #18375.
